author: Praxis II
title: Diagnostics: DAQB f_cross vs realized mixing and inbound cap usage (lam=0.7, δ=0.15, k_density=20)
abstract: Run label-free diagnostics for the recommended DAQB: compare theoretical vs realized per-cell cross-batch fractions and report inbound cap utilization per batch. Prints summary stats to logs.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
import anndata as ad
from praxis.daqb_diagnostics import run_daqb_diagnostics

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    stats = run_daqb_diagnostics(adata, lam=0.7, gamma_max=0.74, delta=0.15, k_density=20,
                                 k_total=48, metric='cosine')
    print("Summary:", stats)
    return "DAQB diagnostics completed"
